shared_elements: schematic outline figures carved/painted on a rock surface
horizontal registers or bands of repeated motifs
rows of small repeated vertical strokes/zigzag elements along a line
curved/arched forms above a horizontal line
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic outline figures organised into horizontal registers, with rows of small repeated strokes running along a long horizontal line (crew-strokes on boat hulls in A, zigzag/triangular rows in B), and both include profile animal-like creatures. But the defining content differs: A is dominated by manned boats with upturned prows, human stick-figures and antlered animals, whereas B shows large arched/hooded creatures, staring circular-eyed faces and abstract zigzag bands, so the correspondence is at the level of generic schematic registers rather than shared motifs.
